name: Marriott Bonvoy Boundless® Credit Card
effective_cost: Low if you redeem the annual free night award
balance_transfer_fee: Either $5 or 5% of the amount of each transfer, whichever is greater
penalty_apr_trigger: Failing to make a Minimum Payment when due, or making a payment that's returned unpaid; can remain in effect indefinitely
pay_over_time_fee: Up to 1.72% per month of the amount selected to pay over time, via Chase Pay Over Time

welcome_bonus.bonus: 125,000 points + 1 Free Night Award (up to a 50,000-point property)
welcome_bonus.requirement: after you spend $3,000 in purchases in the first 3 months from account opening
welcome_bonus.estimated_value: $1,000 for the points alone, per this card's best redemption cpp; the Free Night Award adds more on top

verdict.text: Keep if you'll actually book the annual free night; otherwise a mid-pack earner

earn_note: The 3× categories share one combined $6,000/yr cap across groceries, gas, and dining, easy to blow through if you lean on any single bucket. After that cap (and everywhere else), this card earns a flat 2×, which beats Amex's Bonvoy cards' catch-all rate.

redemption_options.method: Transfer to airline miles (3:1, +5,000 bonus per 60,000 transferred)

points.note: Same Marriott Bonvoy currency and redemption math as Amex's Bonvoy cards. Points are worth the most redeemed for a free night you'd actually book, well above cashing out or transferring to airlines.

transfer_partners.highlight: Marriott Bonvoy transfers to 37 airline programs at 3:1, with a 5,000-mile bonus for every 60,000 points transferred in a single transaction, but no hotel transfer partners, since it already is one.
transfer_partners.recent_changes: Korean Air SKYPASS ended its Marriott transfer partnership in June 2024; some third-party trackers still list it as active, but it is not.

partners.name: Air New Zealand Koru
partners.notes: Well below the standard 3:1 chart. The transfer bonus at this ratio is 75 miles.

partners.name: American Airlines AAdvantage
partners.notes: Does not earn the 5,000-mile transfer bonus other partners get.

partners.name: Avianca LifeMiles
partners.notes: Does not earn the 5,000-mile transfer bonus other partners get.

partners.name: Delta SkyMiles
partners.notes: Does not earn the 5,000-mile transfer bonus other partners get.

partners.name: United MileagePlus
partners.notes: Enhanced partnership: earns a 10,000-mile bonus per 60,000 points transferred, double the standard 5,000-mile bonus.

credits.name: Airline Incidental Credit
credits.subtitle: $50 × 2 · $250 min spend per half · thru 6/30/2027
credits.description: Up to $50 in statement credits twice a year (new accounts: Jun 4 to Dec 31, 2026 and Jan 1 to Jun 30, 2027; accounts open by Jan 7, 2026: Jan to Jun and Jul to Dec 2026) after spending $250 or more on eligible airline purchases within that half, active through June 30, 2027.
tips: Requires $250 of actual airline charges in each 6-month window; general travel spend doesn't count.
This is a limited-time promotional benefit, not a confirmed permanent feature; re-check before assuming it renews past mid-2027.

credits.name: Annual Free Night Award
credits.subtitle: up to 35,000-point category · after account anniversary
credits.description: One free night award each year on your account anniversary, redeemable at hotels with a redemption level at or under 35,000 Marriott Bonvoy points. Valid for 12 months from issuance.
tips: Lower cap than Amex's Bonvoy cards (50k/85k); aim for a property priced near the 35k ceiling to get full value.
$250 here is a conservative mid-range estimate, not a guarantee for any specific hotel.

credits.name: DoorDash DashPass + Credit
credits.subtitle: complimentary + $10/mo non-restaurant
credits.description: Complimentary DashPass membership plus $10 off per month on non-restaurant DoorDash orders for DashPass activated from Sep 1, 2026 (quarterly before that). This figure counts the discount, not the membership.
tips: Skip this if you're not already a DoorDash user; not worth chasing on its own.

insurance.detail: $60,000 · secondary in the US, primary abroad

protection_note: No trip cancellation/interruption, a real step down for a card with an annual fee. Auto rental coverage, baggage delay, trip delay and purchase protection are all here, with limits capped low ($500/item purchase protection, $500/traveler trip delay after a 12-hour trigger).
rental_note: Auto Rental Coverage is included at up to $60,000: secondary in the US, primary outside it, for rentals up to 31 consecutive days. Decline the counter waiver and pay for the whole rental with the card.

status_perks.name: Marriott Bonvoy Silver Elite Status
status_perks.note: Complimentary with the card: 15 Elite Night Credits/year automatically, plus 1 more for every $5,000 spent. Silver is Bonvoy's entry tier; $35,000/yr in card spend unlocks Gold Elite.

services.name: Visa Signature Concierge
services.detail: Complimentary 24/7 concierge for reservations, tickets, and travel arrangements.

additional_cards.title: Additional Cards

benefits.text: Earns Marriott Bonvoy points on their spend (into your account)
Does not get their own Free Night Award or Elite status

additional_cards.note: Additional cards are free: a way to pool household spend toward the 6× hotel rate and the $35,000 Gold Elite threshold.

timeline.text: As of this check, Marriott's airline chart no longer lists Asiana or InterMiles and now lists Ethiopian ShebaMiles and LATAM Pass Brazil, all at 3:1.
The $10 DoorDash non-restaurant promo moves from quarterly to monthly for DashPass activated on or after this date.
New $100/yr Airline Incidental Credit added ($50 semi-annually, $250 min spend per half), running through June 30, 2027.
